evals.prompt: I'm building a Node server that should call Antigravity CLI headlessly whenever a user asks for a repo summary. I want it to reuse my logged-in Google subscription, run in /srv/app, and fail safely if the command hangs. What exact integration pattern should I use?
evals.expected_output: Explains agy -p subprocess usage, cwd handling, auth reuse, print timeout, outer timeout, and stdout/stderr capture.

evals.prompt: I can already run agy manually, but my Python wrapper needs follow-up turns. How do I resume a previous agy conversation from code, and are there any parsing caveats on stdout?
evals.expected_output: Covers --conversation / --continue, how conversation IDs are discovered, and warns that resumed stdout may include prior replies.

evals.prompt: Can I just run agy --sandbox --dangerously-skip-permissions in CI and trust that as my security boundary?
evals.expected_output: Warns against relying on that combination alone, mentions the known sandbox-bypass concern, and recommends external isolation.
